pages.text: None of these places has a bottom you can die on. Fall off the floor of one and you fall into another:$(li)off the $(thing)Bulk$(): back onto our own brane$(li)through the $(thing)Platonic Realm$(): into the Transfinite Hierarchy$(li)below the $(thing)Transfinite$(): into the Quantum Foam

$(li)through a $(thing)black hole$()'s singularity: out of its white hole$(li)past the top of a $(thing)white hole$(): home$(li)between the branches of $(thing)Hyperdimensional Reality$(): into the Bulk$(li)out of the $(thing)Transcendental$(): into Hyperdimensional Reality$(br2)Carry the right attunement for wherever you land.

One world is different. The $(thing)Planetary Interior$() has a true floor - the $(item)Inner Core Boundary$(), solid iron that nothing yet cuts - and a roof of bedrock. There is nothing to fall through: you leave the way you came, by a $(item)Mantle Breach$().

The floor of the Planetary Interior: the edge of the solid inner core, 5,150 km down. Iron here is crystallised under 330 GPa and about 5,400 C - as hot as the Sun's surface, yet solid because the pressure will not let it melt.

A hole bored through bedrock by the Core Drill. Step into it and you fall to the Planetary Interior; on arrival a second breach opens in the floor beside you, and stepping into that one brings you back up.
